info.name: PE Sub Platform
info.description:
REST API collection for the PE Subscription Borrowing Base Platform.

Services
────────
  pe-sub-api         http://localhost:3001   Core API
  pe-sub-extraction  http://localhost:3002   Document extraction

Sync source: pe-sub-docs/openapi.yaml v0.8.0

Before running: update the collection variables (facilityId, lpId, etc.) to match your local seed data.

Authentication — stateless, header-based. In gateway mode every request must carry X-Auth-User and X-Auth-Roles (set the authUser/authRoles collection variables); a missing user header returns 401, an insufficient role 403. In dev mode (default local) the API injects a fixed dev identity, so the headers are optional and may be left as-is. POST /lps/ingest requires the SERVICE role; config and field-mapping mutations require ANALYST. Public routes (/ping, /health, /notifications/**) carry no headers.
